get.description:
Real availability: a solver is only 'available' if its code is loaded; its queue worker
is only 'online' if a live worker answers right now.

schema.title: Response Solvers Api V1 Solvers Get

post.description:
Solve synchronously (fast analytical requests). Unsupported configurations are refused
with reasons; they are never approximated by a simpler model.

Evaluate the fields at one point. Values are returned as float64 JSON numbers, not
interpolated from a sampled grid.
Equations with their applicability status for the model that this scene resolves to.

Flux through closed Gaussian surfaces: surface integral (solid angles over the
represented mesh) and volume integral (enclosed distributional source weights), computed
independently and compared.

200.description: EMF1 container with a FluxHeader (see docs/architecture.md)

post.description:
Ampère's law on closed planar paths: the numerical circulation of H (adaptive
Gauss–Kronrod over the exact path, H from the solver) and, independently, the signed free
current through the spanning surface from the source geometry.

Magnetic flux through stationary surfaces, its time derivative, the induced EMF
∮E_ind·dl and the Faraday comparison at one simulation time, with Lenz's-law signs and
mutual inductances (Phase 4A, magnetoquasistatic).

Induced currents of passive circuits and eddy-current disks over the time range (Phase
4C): the coupled RL equations L dI/dt = EMF_ext − RI − (dL/dt)I, forces, the dynamic
sliding rod and the energy accounting. Every passive current shown anywhere comes from
this solution.

Ideal coaxial cable, TEM mode, at one simulation time: line parameters, V and I (with
their forward/backward waves) at the selected cross-section and along the cable, the
cross-section fields, the Poynting power check, the differential-law checks, the interface
(surface) quantities and the probe. Closed form; no numerical solve.

V(t), I(t) and P(t) at one position, and V and I at the source and load ends, over the
simulation time range (closed form).

Lorentz force F = q(E + v × B) on a test charge at one point and time (Phase 4B): the
electric part from the electrostatic field and the induced field E_ind, the magnetic part
from the magnetostatic B at the instantaneous currents, with powers qE·v and q(v × B)·v.
Nonrelativistic test-particle trajectory in the prescribed fields (Boris scheme).
I(t) and dI/dt of a current profile on an even time grid, for plotting (Phase 4A).

ArrayStats.title: ArrayStats
ArrayStats.description:
Statistics computed in float64 before the float32 transport cast. For vectors they
describe the magnitude; for scalars the signed value.

rho_s_inner_C_per_m2.title: Rho S Inner C Per M2

rho_s_shield_C_per_m2.title: Rho S Shield C Per M2

K_z_inner_A_per_m.title: K Z Inner A Per M

K_z_shield_A_per_m.title: K Z Shield A Per M

Boundary.title: Boundary
Boundary.description: Surface (distributional) quantities on the conductor/dielectric interfaces at z.

BoundaryCondition.title: BoundaryCondition
BoundaryCondition.description:
Boundary condition attached to an object or to the domain boundary.

No Phase 1 solver evaluates boundary conditions; a scene that contains one is refused.

BoxShape.title: BoxShape
BoxShape.description: Width (local x), depth (local y), height (local z).

CircuitSeries.title: CircuitSeries
CircuitSeries.description: Columnar time series on the output grid; per-element lists are indexed [element][k].

CircularLoopSource.title: CircularLoopSource
CircularLoopSource.description:
Ideal thin circular filament carrying a steady current (Phase 3A).

Carried by a ``ring`` primitive with role ``current_source``: centre = world position,
radius = ``radius_m`` times the in-plane world scale, normal n = normalised (c_x x c_y) of the
world matrix. Positive ``current_A`` circulates counter-clockwise about +n (right-hand rule:
B points along +n on the axis). Electrically neutral.

CoaxSpec.title: CoaxSpec
CoaxSpec.description: The complete physical definition of the cable model.

CoilPrimitive.title: CoilPrimitive
CoilPrimitive.description:
Geometry of a finite solenoid (Phase 3B): N coaxial circular turns of radius ``radius_m``
about local +z, turn centres at z_k = -L/2 + k L/(N - 1) (k = 0..N-1); N = 1 is one turn at
z = 0 and ``length_m`` is then not used. L is the distance between the first and last turn
centres; the turn spacing L/(N - 1) is derived, never an input.

CrossSection.title: CrossSection
CrossSection.description: Arrow samples in the cross-section at z (dielectric only), x-y Cartesian.

CurrentSourceInfo.title: CurrentSourceInfo
CurrentSourceInfo.description:
One ideal current filament (Phase 3A), in world coordinates, with its relation to every
plane-grid sampling (for drawing ⊙/⊗ crossings and projections; geometry only).

CylinderShape.title: CylinderShape
CylinderShape.description: Axis along local z; orient it with the surface rotation.

DerivativeInfo.title: DerivativeInfo
DerivativeInfo.description:
How dΦ/dt was obtained: analytically (stationary surface: Σ dI_j/dt Φ_j) or by
Richardson-extrapolated finite differences of the flux values in time (moving surface).

Domain.title: Domain
Domain.description:
Axis-aligned region of interest. It bounds sampling and visualization; the Phase 1
analytical model itself is unbounded (potential reference at infinity).

EddyDisk.title: EddyDisk
EddyDisk.description:
Thin conducting disk in its local xy plane (normal +z), discretized into N_r concentric
annular bands (reduced-order axisymmetric eddy-current approximation).

Electrical.title: Electrical
Electrical.description:
Conductor of a passive circuit. Exactly one of conductivity / resistivity for a custom
material; exactly one of wire radius / cross-section; an explicit lumped resistance, if
given, is authoritative (then σ and the cross-section only matter for ℒ).

ElementInfo.title: ElementInfo
ElementInfo.description: One electrical branch: a passive circuit, or one band of an eddy-current disk.

EquationView.title: EquationView
EquationView.description: An equation resolved against a model context: what the frontend displays.

EquipotentialRequest.title: EquipotentialRequest
EquipotentialRequest.description: Equipotential contour lines on a plane-grid sampling.

FieldLineRequest.title: FieldLineRequest
FieldLineRequest.description:
Ask for field lines. All density levels are computed at once so that changing the
displayed density is a visual-only operation.

``planar``: seeds on a circle in the plane of the referenced plane-grid sampling, around
every source lying in that plane. ``spherical``: seeds on a sphere around every source.

FluxSurface.title: FluxSurface
FluxSurface.description:
A measurement surface: the planar region bounded by the path, oriented by the right-hand
rule (the same geometry and conventions as an Ampère path). ``rtol`` is the relative
tolerance of the Faraday comparison.

Phase 4B (all optional, absent = the Phase 4A stationary surface): ``motion`` moves the
surface and its boundary rigidly (reference pose = ``center_m`` and the rotation);
``turns`` > 1 makes it an explicitly defined N-turn measurement coil of N identical,
coincident, series-connected turns (flux linkage NΦ); the ``sliding_rod`` shape is the
rail generator, whose rod moves by its own ``rod_motion``.

GroupPrimitive.title: GroupPrimitive
GroupPrimitive.description:
A container with no geometry of its own: its transform applies to its children.

``kind = "dipole"`` marks a pair of child point charges +q and −q (two real point charges at
a finite separation, not an ideal point dipole). The kind is an editing aid for the UI; the
physics always comes from the child charges themselves. Added in Phase 2A (additive: scenes
without groups are unchanged, schema_version stays 1).

IdealSolenoidInfo.title: IdealSolenoidInfo
IdealSolenoidInfo.description: Ideal long-solenoid comparison values (an idealization, never the solver's field).

InductionInfo.title: InductionInfo
InductionInfo.description: Status of the time-dependent quantities of a magnetic result (Phase 4A).

InfiniteWireSource.title: InfiniteWireSource
InfiniteWireSource.description:
Ideal infinitely long straight filament carrying a steady current (Phase 3A).

Carried by a ``line`` primitive with role ``current_source``. A point on the axis is the
object's world position; the axis direction d is the normalised world image of local +z.
Positive ``current_A`` flows along +d. The primitive's length is display-only: the model is
infinite and has zero radius. The wire is electrically neutral (no electric field).

IsosurfaceRequest.title: IsosurfaceRequest
IsosurfaceRequest.description: Equipotential surfaces extracted on a lattice (the lattice samples are not transported).

LatticeSampling.title: LatticeSampling
LatticeSampling.description: Regular axis-aligned 3D lattice, inclusive of both ends. Shape (nz, ny, nx[, 3]).

LinePrimitive.title: LinePrimitive
LinePrimitive.description: Straight segment along local z, centred on the local origin.

MagneticContribution.title: MagneticContribution
MagneticContribution.description: Field of one magnetic source at the probe point (Phase 3A; kinds extended in 3B).

Mechanics.title: Mechanics
Mechanics.description:
Sliding rod only. 'prescribed': the rod follows its motion profile; 'dynamic': its
position obeys m d²x/dt² = F_ext + F_em − b dx/dt (x along the rails).

MeshShape.title: MeshShape
MeshShape.description: A custom closed triangulated surface in local coordinates (engine-level for now).

MethodInfo.title: MethodInfo
MethodInfo.description:
How a derived product was obtained. Kept separate from the physical classification of the
field it was derived from: a numerically integrated line of an exact field is still a line
of an exact field.

ModelContext.title: ModelContext
ModelContext.description:
What physical model produced a result. The equation registry derives every equation's
applicability status from this, so statuses are computed rather than hard-coded.

MotionProfile.title: MotionProfile
MotionProfile.description: Rigid motion of a measurement conductor relative to its reference pose.

angular_velocity_left_rad_per_s.title: Angular Velocity Left Rad Per S

angular_velocity_right_rad_per_s.title: Angular Velocity Right Rad Per S

MotionState.title: MotionState
MotionState.description: Instantaneous pose and velocities of a moving measurement conductor (Phase 4B).

u_cross_B_V_per_m.title: U Cross B V Per M

MotionalSample.title: MotionalSample
MotionalSample.description: u, B and u × B at a point of the conductor (for display; values from the engine).

OneSidedValue.title: OneSidedValue
OneSidedValue.description: A one-sided limit at a sheet or core boundary, evaluated at ±offset along the normal.

PassiveCircuit.title: PassiveCircuit
PassiveCircuit.description:
A closed passive conductor: the geometry of a measurement surface's boundary (circle,
rectangle, polygon, sliding rod; optional Phase 4B motion and N series turns) with
electrical properties. Measurement surfaces stay measurement surfaces; a circuit is only
created explicitly.

PassiveContribution.title: PassiveContribution
PassiveContribution.description: One passive circuit's induced-current field at the probe point (Phase 4C).

PassiveProbe.title: PassiveProbe
PassiveProbe.description:
Prescribed and induced-current fields separately (Phase 4C); B and H in ``values`` are
the totals.

PathDisplay.title: PathDisplay
PathDisplay.description: Visualization only: never part of a cache key.

PermanentMagnetSource.title: PermanentMagnetSource
PermanentMagnetSource.description:
Uniformly magnetized cylinder (Phase 3B) on a ``cylinder`` primitive, role
``magnetic_material``: M = M e_z(local) inside, 0 outside. Negative M reverses the polarity.
A prescribed magnetization (no hysteresis, no demagnetization curve).

PlaneGridSampling.title: PlaneGridSampling
PlaneGridSampling.description:
Regular grid on a planar cross-section through the 3D configuration.

Point (i, j) = center + (u_i) * u_dir + (v_j) * v_dir with u_i, v_j spanning
[-extent/2, +extent/2] inclusive. Arrays are stored row-major with shape (nv, nu[, 3]).

PlanePrimitive.title: PlanePrimitive
PlanePrimitive.description: Finite rectangle in the local xy plane (normal along local z).

PointChargeSource.title: PointChargeSource
PointChargeSource.description: Ideal point charge q located at the object's world position.

PointSourceInfo.title: PointSourceInfo
PointSourceInfo.description:
One ideal point charge as a distributional source (Phase 2B-1).

rho = sum_i q_i delta3(r - r_i), so div E = sum_i (q_i/eps0) delta3(r - r_i) and
div D = sum_i q_i delta3(r - r_i). The weights are exact; a delta source has no finite
pointwise value. Its distributional curl contribution is zero (there is no weight for it).

PresetVariant.title: PresetVariant
PresetVariant.description: An alternative configuration of the same preset (Phase 3A: preset 10).

ProbeComparison.title: ProbeComparison
ProbeComparison.description:
An idealized or approximate model evaluated at the probe point for comparison. Never
the solver's field; ``applicable`` says whether its assumptions hold at this point.

ProbeContribution.title: ProbeContribution
ProbeContribution.description: Field of one source at the probe point (one term of the superposition sums).

ProbeDiagnostic.title: ProbeDiagnostic
ProbeDiagnostic.description:
Finite-difference estimate of an operator applied to the exact field. A numerical check
with an uncertainty, never the result: the exact value is given alongside.

ProbeDistributional.title: ProbeDistributional
ProbeDistributional.description: What holds at a point-charge position, where only distributions are meaningful.

ProbeMagnetic.title: ProbeMagnetic
ProbeMagnetic.description: Magnetic part of the probe; present when the scene has magnetic sources.

ProfileSampleBody.title: ProfileSampleBody
ProfileSampleBody.description: Sample a current profile for display (Phase 4A); evaluated by the engine.

RingPrimitive.title: RingPrimitive
RingPrimitive.description: Circle in the local xy plane.

Role.title: Role
Role.description:
Physical role of an object. ``geometry_only`` objects are inert: they are drawn but are
explicitly excluded from the physical model (and reported as such in every result).

ScalarCheck.title: ScalarCheck
ScalarCheck.description:
One side of a differential law: the analytic value (from the wave derivatives) and an
independent central finite difference of the field itself.

SelfInductance.title: SelfInductance
SelfInductance.description:
'thin_loop': μ₀a[ln(8a/r_w) − 2] for a circular loop of round wire (r_w/a ≤ 0.1), times
N² for N coincident turns; 'user': the given value.

SlidingRodShape.title: SlidingRodShape
SlidingRodShape.description:
Sliding-rod generator (Phase 4B), in the surface's local frame: two stationary rails
along +x at y = ±L/2 from x = 0 to x = rail_length, a stationary connecting segment at
x = 0, and a straight rod joining the rails at x(t) = rod_position + d_x(t). The circuit is
the rectangle [0, x(t)] × [−L/2, L/2]; only the rod moves (velocity along the rails).

SolenoidSource.title: SolenoidSource
SolenoidSource.description:
Finite solenoid (Phase 3B) on a ``coil`` primitive, role ``current_source``: every turn
carries the signed current I, counter-clockwise about local +z for I > 0.

Stations.title: Stations
Stations.description: Cross-sections along the cable for the 3D view: per station V, I and sample vectors.

SurfaceDisplay.title: SurfaceDisplay
SurfaceDisplay.description: Visualization metadata. Ignored by the engine and excluded from every cache key.

TestCharge.title: TestCharge
TestCharge.description:
A test charge (Phase 4B): the Lorentz-force probe (charge, laboratory-frame velocity,
position) and the initial state and controls of its optional trajectory.

TimeHint.title: TimeHint
TimeHint.description:
Simulation-time range and step a time-dependent preset opens with (Phase 4A). The
physics at a time t does not depend on these; they only set the playback.

dI_dt_left_A_per_s.title: Di Dt Left A Per S

TimeSourceInfo.title: TimeSourceInfo
TimeSourceInfo.description: A current source at the simulation time (Phase 4A).

ToroidFiniteSource.title: ToroidFiniteSource
ToroidFiniteSource.description:
Finite-turn toroid (Phase 3B) on a ``torus`` primitive: N circular turns of radius
b_winding, each counter-clockwise about its local +e_phi for I > 0. Vacuum: no core.

ToroidIdealSource.title: ToroidIdealSource
ToroidIdealSource.description:
Ideal continuous-winding toroid (Phase 3B) on a ``torus`` primitive, with a homogeneous
linear core of relative permeability mu_r and minor radius b_core:
H = N I / (2 pi rho) e_phi and B = mu0 mu_r H inside the core, zero outside (idealization).

TorusPrimitive.title: TorusPrimitive
TorusPrimitive.description:
Geometry of a toroidal winding (Phase 3B), symmetric about local +z.

``winding_radius_m`` (b_winding) is the radius of each circular turn of the finite-turn
model; ``core_radius_m`` (b_core) is the minor radius of the ideal model's core. They are
separate parameters: each model uses only its own. Turn k of the finite model sits at
phi_k = phase + 2 pi k / N.

TrajectorySettings.title: TrajectorySettings
TrajectorySettings.description: Trajectory controls of a test charge (persisted with a project).

Transform.title: Transform
Transform.description:
Local transform relative to the parent object (or to the world if there is no parent).

``rotation_euler_xyz_rad`` uses the rotation matrix R = Rx(a) @ Ry(b) @ Rz(c), which is the
Three.js default Euler order ``'XYZ'``. Composition: M = T @ R @ S.

TurnGeometry.title: TurnGeometry
TurnGeometry.description: One circular filament (a loop, or one turn of a solenoid or finite toroid), world.

UniformReference.title: UniformReference
UniformReference.description: Idealized uniform-field reference (an approximation, never the result).

ViewHint.title: ViewHint
ViewHint.description: View the preset opens with (display only; never part of the physics).

shared_face_max_abs_sum_E_V_m.title: Shared Face Max Abs Sum E V M

cell_flux_difference_E_V_m.title: Cell Flux Difference E V M

sum_cell_volume_integral_E_V_m.title: Sum Cell Volume Integral E V M
